# Maahir Garg

> Maahir Garg is an AI Engineer at GIC and a Computer Science & Quantitative
> Finance student at the National University of Singapore (NUS), based in
> Singapore. He builds agentic LLM tooling for classified-data environments
> and co-invented a multimodal hand-tracking framework on Apple Vision Pro
> for stroke rehabilitation (patent application in progress).

Key facts:

- Role: AI Engineer at GIC (Singapore's sovereign wealth fund), building an
  internal agentic CLI agent and LLM pipelines that automate audit workflows.
- Education: Bachelor of Computing, Computer Science & Quantitative Finance,
  National University of Singapore (2023–2027).
- Research: multimodal iPhone + Apple Vision Pro hand-tracking framework for
  stroke rehabilitation at Interactive 3D Lab, 89% cross-device accuracy
  (patent application in progress); BERT quantization/pruning (~69% smaller,
  <0.5% F1 loss); PEFT/BitFit experiments on LLM reasoning.
- Teaching: Algorithms, Data Structures, and Discrete Structures at NUS
  across three semesters (4.8/5.0 student rating).
- Interests: photography, badminton, Formula 1, chess.
